text:
Wagon theme options (theme -> scope):
- mechanic: core game rules, decision systems, immediate feedback loops
- scenario: content ingestion, entity extraction, narrative structure processing
- match: session orchestration, state management, lifecycle control; multi-player coordination, turn management
- sensory: UI rendering, audio mixing, gesture capture, player interaction
- player: individual lifecycle, onboarding, progression, session management
- league: competitive organization, bracket management, tournament operations
- audience: spectator engagement, streaming infrastructure, viewer participation
- monetization: token economy, wallet operations, transaction processing
- partnership: sponsor/partner onboarding, delegation, commercial integration
- commons: shared infrastructure, cross-cutting utilities, platform services

coverage.note: All 10 themes and their scopes reproduced verbatim as one bullet per theme; match keeps both scope groups.

variants.note: Canonical text preserves all ten theme-to-scope mappings, including both match scope groups. Differences are formatting, capitalization, and conjunctions only; no knowledge is lost.

audit.summary: All variant knowledge is carried by canonical text; no notGeneric exclusions are needed.
